validity.researcher_notes: The Tuscarora XPress Project modifies the existing Wadsworth Compressor Station in Washoe County, Nevada. FERC Docket No. CP20-486-000, Tuscarora Gas Transmission Company, Notice of Application, published Federal Register Vol. 85, July 14, 2020 (govinfo package 2020-15043): the notice describes replacing/adding a compressor unit ('a new 1,380 HP reciprocating compressor unit') and associated 'facilities at its existing Wadsworth CS (Tuscarora XPress Project)' -- a compressor upgrade only, no new pipeline segment described. This is consistent with the sheet's own StartLocation=Malin (OR) / EndState=Nevada framing of the parent system and the already-recorded LengthKnownKm=0.00. Per standing protocol ('expansion with no new physical pipe -> LengthKnown=0, Diameter=blank'), the blank Diameter is the correct answer for this specific expansion project row, distinct from the Tuscarora Gas Pipeline mainline itself (which the wiki separately documents at 20 inches, i.e. 508 mm, on its own system-level row).
